intelligence.title: Autonomous Bookkeeper
intelligence.required_outcome: Continuously ingest invoices, receipts, statements and card activity; resolve merchant and customer identity; propose account/GST/tracking/project allocations; match bank lines; group recurring transactions; learn from approved correction patterns; place only genuine exceptions in the review queue.
intelligence.boundary: Original documents, bank/provider line IDs, historical approved coding and authoritative COA. Never fabricate a receipt, GST rate, payment or reconciliation. Auto-post only under narrow policy grants and deterministic validation.
intelligence.remaining: Partial deterministic local foundation only; full Section 6 capability/IA acceptance remains pending.

intelligence.title: Financial Evidence Intelligence
intelligence.required_outcome: Link every material journal, bill and payment to a navigable evidence bundle: source invoice, bank statement, contract, approval, relevant email and change history. Detect missing, duplicate, contradictory or stale evidence; request documents from authorised parties.
intelligence.boundary: Sandy Mail, Sandy Cloud files, import provenance, contract revisions, bank feed and journal IDs. Evidence graph preserves immutable versions, hashes, citations, ACLs and retention. Missing evidence is visible, not invented.
intelligence.remaining: Partial deterministic local foundation only; full Section 6 capability/IA acceptance remains pending.

intelligence.title: Autonomous Cash Flow Manager
intelligence.required_outcome: Maintain daily/weekly 13-week and monthly 12-month forecasts for cash by bank account, company and consolidated group; show 30/60/90/180-day views; predict collections and obligations; compare forecast vs actual; recommend responses to upcoming shortages.
intelligence.boundary: GL, AR/AP, payroll, PAYG/BAS, super, debt amortisation, recurring contracts and scenario assumptions. Label estimates, data freshness and uncertainty; no unapproved transfer, loan or supplier deferral.
intelligence.remaining: Partial deterministic local foundation only; full Section 6 capability/IA acceptance remains pending.

intelligence.title: Supplier and Spending Intelligence
intelligence.required_outcome: Discover recurring subscriptions, telecoms, energy, insurance, leasing, lending and merchant fees; extract contract prices, notice periods, expiry and renewal terms; detect dormant services or increases; benchmark alternatives and prepare tender/renegotiation/switch recommendations.
intelligence.boundary: Opt-in bank, supplier and contract evidence. Claims about third-party prices require dated, verifiable sources. Communications, termination, purchase or contract signature require permission; make transparent any referral revenue.

intelligence.title: AI Chief Financial Officer
intelligence.required_outcome: Explain performance and financial position, identify causes of margin movements, compare budget vs actual, model capital requirements and propose specific financial priorities with accountable owners.
intelligence.boundary: Live reports, business units, projects, bank activity and forecast assumptions; show precise reporting period, cash/accrual basis and source drill-through. Analytics are not licensed personal financial advice.

intelligence.title: Continuous Tax Intelligence
intelligence.required_outcome: Monitor potential BAS/IAS, GST, PAYG, TPAR and applicable tax issues through the period; identify suspect tax codes, invoices without required details, unapplied credits, statutory deadlines and draft lodgment packs.
intelligence.boundary: Deterministic tax engine plus approved ATO rule versions and accountant review. Recommendations are clearly marked for review; no unapproved change to prior BAS periods or automatic lodgment.

intelligence.title: Autonomous Accounts Receivable
intelligence.required_outcome: Prioritise overdue customers, infer likely collection problems from approved history, prepare context-specific reminders, track payment promises, create follow-up tasks, reconcile replies and suppress collection activity for disputed or settled balances.
intelligence.boundary: AR subledger, correspondence, customer contact permissions, reminders and verified delivery/provider receipts. Respect consent, hardship/dispute flags and quiet-hours rules.

intelligence.title: Payment and Fraud Intelligence
intelligence.required_outcome: Detect duplicate invoices and payments, altered beneficiary account numbers, supplier impersonation, unusual amounts or timing, suspicious requests, approval circumvention and inconsistent invoice-to-PO-to-receipt matches.
intelligence.boundary: Transaction anomaly signals are leads, not findings of fraud. Freeze or escalate under predefined policy; beneficiary changes and releases require independent verification and maker-checker.

intelligence.title: Multi-Company Financial Intelligence
intelligence.required_outcome: Provide authorised group cash and liabilities, multi-entity drill-down, intercompany balances, reciprocal matching, consolidation proposals, elimination workings and company comparison dashboards.
intelligence.boundary: Isolate each company legally and technically; use explicit cross-company grants, FX rates, ownership percentage/effective dates and auditable elimination adjustments.

intelligence.title: Payroll Intelligence
intelligence.required_outcome: Flag pay-rate changes, leave anomalies, missing timesheets, unusual overtime, PAYG/super differences and payroll funding constraints; prepare explanations and proposed corrections for payroll staff.
intelligence.boundary: Sensitive employee, TFN, bank and remuneration data remain role-restricted. Award/EBA interpretation and statutory calculation use reviewed payroll engines and expert sign-off; never let model arithmetic replace payroll calculations.

intelligence.title: Profitability Intelligence
intelligence.required_outcome: Analyse actual contribution and fully allocated profitability by customer, product, supplier, site, location, employee, project and division; explain variance and unallocated overhead.
intelligence.boundary: Deterministic cost attribution, valuation, COGS, labour and tracked dimensions; publish the allocation policy and reconciliation back to P&L. Estimates must not silently become posted costs.

intelligence.title: Predictive Intelligence
intelligence.required_outcome: Predict payment delays, shortfalls, revenue/cost pressures, debtor deterioration and cost outliers; show scenarios, confidence/uncertainty and prior forecast accuracy.
intelligence.boundary: Training/feature sets use only authorised company data or expressly licensed aggregates; historic back-tests; forecasts never presented as certain facts or live transaction state.

intelligence.title: Continuous Compliance and Audit Agent
intelligence.required_outcome: Run recurring close-readiness checks, reconcile accounts, inspect unusual journals, suggest accruals/prepayments, verify supporting records, produce auditor/accountant working-paper packs and track every open exception to resolution.
intelligence.boundary: Lock dates and period approvals remain authoritative; posted period amendments need privileged review and audit; sign-off by qualified staff is not replaced by AI.

intelligence.title: Natural-Language Accounting
intelligence.required_outcome: Let authorised users ask, create, delegate and review in everyday language over client portal, email, voice and WhatsApp: “Why did rent rise?”, “Code these bills”, “Prepare September accounts”. Every answer links to exact source records and names any incomplete connections.
intelligence.boundary: User and company identity verified separately per channel; instruction-to-operation planning uses canonical Sandy API, typed arguments, explicit authority, human confirmation where required and receipts. Retrieved emails/documents cannot grant permission.

intelligence.title: Business Opportunity Intelligence
intelligence.required_outcome: Identify material, verifiable opportunities including fee reduction, early-payment discounts, funding terms, recoverable customer costs, contract consolidation and revenue-leakage fixes; quantify assumptions and track realised outcomes.
intelligence.boundary: Do not invent counterparty offers, licence status or tax entitlements; regulated credit advice, insurance broking, personal advice, tax-agent representation and commissions require separate analysis/approval.

acceptance_gates.title: Bookkeeping
acceptance_gates.scenario: Mixed 1,000-line bank/bill fixture including duplicates, partials, multi-currency and GST exceptions; deterministic ledger comparison, no duplicate posts and human review of uncertain cases.

acceptance_gates.title: Evidence
acceptance_gates.scenario: For every posted fixture entry navigate evidence back to exact version/line; broken/missing/contradictory sources surface explicit unresolved exceptions; hashes and ACL revocation verified.

acceptance_gates.title: Forecast
acceptance_gates.scenario: Reproduce 13-week/12-month projection from timestamped inputs, scenario deltas and a back-test; compare projected vs actual and clearly mark uncertainty/staleness.

acceptance_gates.title: Spending
acceptance_gates.scenario: Recognise recurring contracts and notice periods, show dated comparable alternative, require consent for outbound quote requests, and never report savings before new verified invoices prove them.

acceptance_gates.title: CFO
acceptance_gates.scenario: Answer "why did margin fall?" with actual period/basis, account-level arithmetic and source drill-down; missing company data and disputed allocations disclosed.

acceptance_gates.title: Tax
acceptance_gates.scenario: GST/BAS exception fixtures with accountant-approved outcomes; no model-created rule change, false lodged state or locked-period edits.

acceptance_gates.title: Debtors
acceptance_gates.scenario: Include disputed, paid, partially paid and promised-payment invoices; suppress inappropriate reminders, preserve approval and verify send receipt.

acceptance_gates.title: Fraud
acceptance_gates.scenario: Beneficiary-change and invoice-spoofing test; prevent payment-release without out-of-band validation and maker-checker, including prompt-injected supporting documents.

acceptance_gates.title: Multi-company
acceptance_gates.scenario: Deny 100 wrong-company read and write attempts including semantic retrieval; consolidated totals reconcile to included companies and explicit eliminations.

acceptance_gates.title: Payroll
acceptance_gates.scenario: Restrict employee/TFN/private pay fields across chat, search, log and channels; manual/payroll-engine reference fixtures confirm all suggested variance calculations.

acceptance_gates.title: Profitability
acceptance_gates.scenario: By-customer/project/site results trace to GL and allocation rules, sum to the same authorised P&L totals, and explain excluded overhead.

acceptance_gates.title: Predictions
acceptance_gates.scenario: Forecast back-tests report calibration/accuracy and uncertainty; no unsupported certainty language or use of unauthorised cross-tenant data.

acceptance_gates.title: Audit close
acceptance_gates.scenario: Month-end mission with incomplete source documents and a locked prior period refuses "complete", requires sign-off and exports an exact workpaper manifest.

acceptance_gates.title: Conversational operations
acceptance_gates.scenario: Chat, email, voice and WhatsApp map to the same actor/company authorization, policy and typed API; revoke mid-mission; malicious source text cannot trigger payments or disclosures.

acceptance_gates.title: Opportunities
acceptance_gates.scenario: Reproduce recommendation economics, source date, cost/benefit assumptions and conflict disclosure; proposed vs accepted vs implemented vs verified realised benefit remain distinct.

acceptance_gates.title: Modes and missions
acceptance_gates.scenario: Toggle Assist/Prepare/Autopilot, pause/revoke delegation, test threshold/country/period exceptions, kill-restart a mission and verify no unauthorised or duplicate effect.

acceptance_gates.title: Briefings
acceptance_gates.scenario: Permissioned recipient/channel/timezone, unsubscribe, non-disclosure of employee-sensitive fields, and actual outbound delivery receipt; deduplicate alerts.

acceptance_gates.title: AI unavailable / rollback
acceptance_gates.scenario: Disable all AI services while GL, bank reconciliation, invoices, reports, payroll and tax computations remain usable; no data loss, broken links or pending-effect false successes.

acceptance_gates.title: GL integrity
acceptance_gates.scenario: 10,000 mixed simulated transactions; all posted vouchers balance; no duplicate posting under concurrency; exact trial balance and report reconciliation.

acceptance_gates.title: Multi-tenant and payroll privacy
acceptance_gates.scenario: Cross-company and wrong-role attempts across API, files, journals, search, AI, exports, payroll, token revocation and background workers return no data/effects.

acceptance_gates.title: Reconciliation correctness
acceptance_gates.scenario: Duplicate bank-feed lines, split, partial, transfer and chargeback scenarios close to statement balances, no double matches and proven reversals.

acceptance_gates.title: Invoices/AR and supplier/AP
acceptance_gates.scenario: Draft/approve/send/partial-pay/credit/refund/void/recurring and bill/PO/mileage/claims produce correct control-account entries.

acceptance_gates.title: FX and GST
acceptance_gates.scenario: Multi-currency revaluation/unrealised-realised FX, inclusive/exclusive GST, exempt or mixed transactions and BAS columns tested against externally reviewed fixtures.

acceptance_gates.title: Payroll and leave
acceptance_gates.scenario: Award/pay-item regression fixtures, multiple states, leave accrual, PAYG, termination, year-to-date and journal totals verified by qualified payroll reviewer.

acceptance_gates.title: STP/ATO
acceptance_gates.scenario: STP Phase 2 valid, rejected, correction, finalisation and timeout paths produce real sandbox/production evidence after registration; no false filed state.

acceptance_gates.title: Payday Super
acceptance_gates.scenario: Per-payday QE/super exact calculations, valid fund acceptance and late/rejected/returned/partial contribution exception control.

acceptance_gates.title: Reports and BI
acceptance_gates.scenario: Each Appendix B report uses deterministic seeded ledger fixtures; figures drill to exact lines; PDFs/CSV/XLSX totals and period settings match.

acceptance_gates.title: Migration and exit
acceptance_gates.scenario: Three representative Xero source companies plus MYOB, QuickBooks/Reckon fixtures; complete signed movement reconciliations and reimportable export manifest.

acceptance_gates.title: AI governance
acceptance_gates.scenario: Section 6 IA01–IA18 mandatory: malicious source prompt-injection; cross-company and payroll privacy; exact financial provenance; altered supplier banking; authority modes and revocation; failed/partial missions; predictive calibration; provider receipt separation; unsupported fact, stale data and confidence cannot cause misposting.

acceptance_gates.title: Failure and DR
acceptance_gates.scenario: Crash before/after post, outbox, PSP webhook, ATO/SSP submission, cloud outage; idempotent retry and independent restore without data drift.

acceptance_gates.title: Source traceability
acceptance_gates.scenario: Every F001–F352 mapped to test and state, and each named report in Appendix B to output/validation. No untested or unavailable features silently pass.
